name: studded leather
_deep_note: Returns deep (deep_bell) in the drake and dragon leathers: drakeskin from floor 35, dragonhide from 55. Brandon's defence-model decision 20 (2026-11-17): a Dexterity hero finds light and medium armour all the way down; it keeps the template's lower AC (the trade for the dodge and the speed).
_design_note: F10-25 light. Bridges leather to medium.
lore_template: A jerkin of {material_name} riveted with iron studs across the chest and shoulders. The studs catch glancing blades that the hide alone would let through.

forms_words.blunt: takes the sting from a blow

forms_note: Leather set with rivets: it slows an edge and takes the sting from a blow.
